details:
When I put on a Generic avatar with a custom Action layer, I see the Action pose before any Playable Layer Control runs. Remote player can see it too. My Humanoid version starts in the Base pose.

How to check

* Put on https://vrchat.com/home/avatar/avtr_3140df12-9c00-4045-a40d-25726fa4e3e8

* In Desktop, press F5 to see the result

I expected Base to show first because the docs say Action starts at zero weight. Is the Generic behavior intended? If it is, could the docs mention the difference? https://creators.vrchat.com/avatars/playable-layers/#action

How to reproduce the avatar

* Start with a Generic rig and a VRC Avatar Descriptor. Add a visible cube as a child of the avatar root.

* Create two Animator Controllers, each with a single default state. In the Base controller, use a clip that holds the cube low. In the Action controller, use a clip that holds the same cube high. Animate the cube’s local position in both clips.

* In the descriptor, customize Playable Layers and assign the controllers to Base and Action.

* Upload and wear the avatar. The cube appears high in the Action pose.
title: Generic avatars show the Action pose on load
